svg.title: Vault — bank safe robot
svg.desc: A chubby navy teal robot shaped like an old bank safe, its door trimmed with a gold pinstripe and fitted with a combination dial and a spoked wheel handle, two eyes behind brass peep lenses in a short head under a cornice, heavy slate arms ending in a clamp and a stethoscope disc, on stubby legs and block feet.
